name: Tobacco
overview: Scripture calls believers to live by the Spirit rather than the flesh, which includes honoring God with our bodies as a living sacrifice. Tobacco use, including chewing tobacco, can be seen as a matter of the flesh that believers are urged to overcome by walking in the Spirit and not conforming to worldly habits. The renewing of the mind enables Christians to discern and follow God's perfect will, avoiding actions that manifest the works of the flesh and instead embracing holiness and self-control.
